publicSources.supportedClaims: All seven numbered senses and their examples were returned before the later long synonym tail: intense cold, clear visibility, clear musical sound, vivid colour/appearance, mental/bodily alertness, deft performance and often-negative unsatisfactory appearance/results. Modern下一 and classicalさゆ are distinguished. Attested今日は頭が冴えている and目が冴えて眠れない support the proposed core contexts and subjectが.
publicSources.limits: The synonym tail was truncated and is not claimed fully read. The × marker is outside the Joyo kanji table, not a frequency rating or proof the native pronunciation is rare. Classicalさゆ is not added to the frozen reading lists. No invented transitive master-a-skill construction.

unsuccessfulLookup.disposition: Use only the actual complete frozen JMdict1877830 rare-term family for冴寒ごかん. Do not claim public corroboration or ordinary use. This is not a permission denial.

lexicalDecisions.decision: One necessary new冴えるさえる support article. Preserve all six main senses, rare-spelling冱える and contextual negative notes in evidence. Teach useful intransitive ichidan mental clarity and vividness;目が冴える means wakefulness, not eye brightness or waking from sleep. 頭の冴えた is an attested prenominal construction, not a new per-kanji reading. Briefly recognize deft performance and the somewhat old-fashioned intense-cold branch without claiming every use is cold or rare.

Complete noun families support clarity and dexterity. 冴 without writtenえ is flagged irregular okurigana in1297040. No noun article is necessary for the selectedさ.える row; do not substitute nounさえ or nanori for the verb metadata.

冴寒ごかん means extreme cold and is explicitly a rare term. It supplies qualified recognition evidence forゴ, corroborated separately as字音 in字通, but gets no new support article and no on practice question. No additionalコ example is established by this family.

Keep complete shining/gradual clearing/clear-and-cold compounds. 冴え渡る and冴えわたる are retained ordinary spellings;さえ渡る/冴渡る are search-only. 冴返る has irregular okurigana. These are not examples forこお.る orひ.える merely because an English gloss mentions freezing/cold. Do not infer frequency from absent priorities.

Repeated forms and negative冴えない have their own construction/POS information. Preserve rare alternate冱え冱え and search-only冴々/冴冴 separately. Negative lacklustre/unsatisfactory/unappealing senses do not mean literally unable to see clearly, and are not a fixed judgement of intelligence. No additional support quota.

comparisonDecisions.decision: 覚める/目覚める focus on waking or coming to awareness, unlike remaining wide awake in目が冴える. Existing覚める's displayed regain-alertness branch nevertheless merits a conservative direct quiz guard. No current目覚める article was found.

Shining, clear resonance and vivid colour share contextual meanings with冴える. Inspect actual existing光る/輝く/澄む bodies and use direct guards without asserting unrestricted substitution. No current鮮やか article; search-only鮮か/彩やか are not promoted. 清む alias and澄む's unvoiced-pronunciation sense stay local.
Exact main family is repeated intentionally for comparison navigation; count36 occurrences but35 distinct families.

Skill/excellence can overlap冴える's deft-performance sense even though the proposed main title emphasizes mental clarity and vividness. Guard actual上手/優れる labels directly. Retain obsoleteじょうて/じょうしゅ and reading-restrictedかみて/うわて senses; do not relabel the existingじょうず article.

冷えるひえる and凍るこおる are genuine independent primary articles, not reuses for冴's alternative source readings. Neither complete family lists冴 as its spelling. Do not manufacture冴る/冴えるひえる examples. Coldness and literal freezing are distinct; no baseline article rewrite is proposed.

relatedDecisions.decision: Actualすっきり/鋭い/透き通る/明るい bodies and full local senses support conservative direct clarity/mental-keenness/bright-colour guards. Physical blade sharpness, water transparency and room illumination are not unrestricted meanings of冴える. Preserve negative-polarityすっきり, search-only尖い/透きとおる/明い and all alias distinctions.

器用/上手い skill labels can fit deft performance; guard direct pairs. Inうまい, esp. spelling notes are tendencies rather than exclusive restrictions; taste/profit senses are not assigned to冴える. No existing titles, levels or exclusions change.

寒い weather and凍える bodily intense cold can fit the older coldness branch. Conservative direct guards do not claim all cooling/freezing constructions are interchangeable. 寒い's weak-joke sense does not turn positive冴える into a negative dullness synonym.
